title: Modern Abstraction
coreMove: Use modern systems as lenses while adding a deliberate return path to lived reality.
sourcePressure: Extends abstraction into modern scale, metrics, and systems: tools create clarity while widening the gap between authority and consequence.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the chapter into anti-technology or anti-scale instead of managing the distance modern tools create.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
